title: pssc cov diff --json
description: The statements and branch arms of a coverage report (pssunit.coverage/1 JSON or a pssc test --cov .cdb) with 0 hits whose source line was added or changed in the working tree since a git revision (git diff -U0 BASE). Gaps have the pssc.cov-gaps/1 shape. Fields not listed here may be added; readers ignore them.

changed.description: The files with added or changed lines, relative to the git root. Untracked files are not included.

summary.description: Gaps per kind (register and bin are always 0: they have no source line).
